room_description: A modern bedroom with tan wood paneling, a large double bed with a brown and black runner, a desk with a computer on the left, a wall-mounted ship painting, and a vertical heater unit on the right.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the bedroom interior.
Removing the heater grate to find a hidden compartment.
Lifting the bed runner to find a golden star-shaped token.
Tapping the wall shelves to collect a small white model bicycle.
Inspecting the smartphone on the desk to see notification numbers.
Finding a numeric lock box inside the desk drawer.
Retreiving a yellow pencil and a screwdriver from a different cabinet section.
Opening a hidden wall safe behind the heater area using the screwdriver.
Using tokens to unlock a specialized box hidden in a wall niche.
Retrieving the exit key and opening the door.

solution_steps: Check the smartphone on the left desk.
Note the counts: Calls (2), Messages (5), Updates (8).
Enter '258' into the numeric box inside the desk drawer.
Locate the vertical heater/grate on the right wall.
Use the screwdriver to remove the screws and the grate.
Collect the half-moon token from inside.
Navigate to the hidden wall niche (behind the ship painting).
Insert the star token and the moon token into the wooden box.
The box opens to reveal the key.

final_action: The player uses the silver key on the main wooden door to unlock it and exit the room.
